sourceInstructions: <root xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/sqlserver/2004/07/adventure-works/ProductModelManuInstructions">AI-generated fictional demo instructions. Not validated engineering or safety instructions. Mountain-300. Fictional workshop demonstration for Mountain-300 model 21, using Mountain-300 Black, 38 (BK-M47B-38) as the representative product. It covers frame preparation, subassembly checks and final assembly.<Location LocationID="20" SetupHours="0.3" LaborHours="1.5" MachineHours="0.8" LotSize="1">Work Center 20 - Frame Welding. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Inferred frame welding stage for the representative frame, using supplied manufactured frame components.<step>Inventory 1 EA each of <material>Head Tube (Product Number HT-8019)</material>, <material>Top Tube (Product Number TO-2301)</material>, <material>Down Tube (Product Number DT-2377)</material> and <material>Seat Tube (Product Number ST-9828)</material>, plus 2 EA of <material>Chain Stays (Product Number CS-2812)</material> and 4 EA of <material>Seat Stays (Product Number SS-2985)</material>.</step><step>Arrange the frame components in an assumed <tool>frame assembly jig</tool> and demonstrate joining them to form <material>ML Mountain Frame - Black, 38 (Product Number FR-M63B-38)</material>. Exact joint geometry and welding settings are outside this demonstration.</step></Location><Location LocationID="30" SetupHours="0.1" LaborHours="0.4" MachineHours="0.1" LotSize="1">Work Center 30 - Debur and Polish. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Inferred deburring and visual preparation of the joined frame before finishing.<step>Use an assumed <tool>deburring tool</tool> to remove obvious rough edges from <material>ML Mountain Frame - Black, 38 (Product Number FR-M63B-38)</material>, then visually check the joined areas.</step></Location><Location LocationID="40" SetupHours="0.2" LaborHours="0.5" MachineHours="0.2" LotSize="1">Work Center 40 - Paint. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Inferred black finishing and decal application for the representative frame.<step>Demonstrate finishing <material>ML Mountain Frame - Black, 38 (Product Number FR-M63B-38)</material> with <material>Paint - Black (Product Number PA-187B)</material>; the frame BOM allocates 8 OZ. No application or curing settings are specified.</step><step>After the finish is ready for handling, apply 2 EA of <material>Decal 1 (Product Number DC-8732)</material> and 1 EA of <material>Decal 2 (Product Number DC-9824)</material>; visually check the finish and decals.</step></Location><Location LocationID="50" SetupHours="0.2" LaborHours="1.0" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 50 - Subassembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Inferred subassembly inventory and preparation before final assembly.<step>Inspect the supplied <material>ML Fork (Product Number FK-5136)</material> and prepare it with the finished <material>ML Mountain Frame - Black, 38 (Product Number FR-M63B-38)</material> for final assembly.</step><step>Inventory the components of <material>ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451)</material>: 1 EA each of <material>Adjustable Race (Product Number AR-5381)</material>, <material>Keyed Washer (Product Number KW-4091)</material>, <material>Lock Nut 19 (Product Number LN-9080)</material>, <material>Lower Head Race (Product Number LR-8520)</material> and <material>Crown Race (Product Number CR-9981)</material>, and 8 EA of <material>Headset Ball Bearings (Product Number BE-2908)</material>. Their assembly order and mating geometry are not established by the supplied BOM.</step><step>Check the supplied <material>ML Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M237)</material>, <material>ML Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M763)</material>, <material>ML Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M762)</material> and <material>ML Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M762)</material> for obvious damage before fitting.</step></Location><Location LocationID="60" SetupHours="0.2" LaborHours="1.5" MachineHours="0.0" LotSize="1">Work Center 60 - Final Assembly. Estimates are fictional demo assumptions. Final assembly and simple visual checks; the historical route records this work center for the representative product.<step>Place 1 EA of <material>ML Mountain Frame - Black, 38 (Product Number FR-M63B-38)</material> in an assumed <tool>assembly stand</tool> and fit 1 EA of <material>ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451)</material> with the frame's fork. See the schematic arrangement in illustration <diag>100211</diag>.</step><step>Fit 1 EA each of <material>ML Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M763)</material> and <material>ML Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M237)</material> to the frame.</step><step>Fit 1 EA of <material>ML Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M762)</material> at the front and 1 EA of <material>ML Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M762)</material> at the rear.</step><step>Fit 1 EA each of <material>ML Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-8107)</material>, <material>ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583)</material> and <material>ML Mountain Pedal (Product Number PD-M340)</material>. The direct BOM lists the pedal component as 1 EA; do not infer an additional quantity.</step><step>Fit 1 EA each of <material>Front Derailleur (Product Number FD-2342)</material>, <material>Rear Derailleur (Product Number RD-2308)</material> and <material>Chain (Product Number CH-0234)</material> in their respective drivetrain positions.</step><step>Fit 1 EA each of <material>Front Brakes (Product Number FB-9873)</material> and <material>Rear Brakes (Product Number RB-9231)</material> at the front and rear respectively.</step><step>Visually check the assembled components for obvious damage or interference and observe that the wheels turn. Set aside the demonstration assembly for further assessment rather than treating these checks as a release for riding.</step></Location></root>
processNotes: The historical record places product 785 at Final Assembly, location 60; all other routing and the order shown are inferred, not an engineering specification.
Manufactured components not built in the steps are assumed to arrive complete. Purchased components are fitted or inspected, not manufactured in this demonstration.
Final checks are simple demonstration observations and do not establish roadworthiness.
variantNotes: The representative product is black, size 38, and uses frame 814, FR-M63B-38.

Black size 40 product 786 uses frame 830, FR-M63B-40; black size 44 product 787 uses frame 831, FR-M63B-44; black size 48 product 788 uses frame 832, FR-M63B-48. Do not substitute the size 38 frame for these variants.
The supplied direct BOMs list the same other components and quantities for all four variants, including front wheel 816 and rear wheel 824. No variant-specific wheel or color substitution is shown.
The description specifically concerns the black size 48 product; it is not a specification for the representative size 38 product.

100211.title: Representative bicycle assembly overview
guidance: Place 1 EA of ML Mountain Frame - Black, 38 (Product Number FR-M63B-38) in an assumed assembly stand and fit 1 EA of ML Headset (Product Number HS-2451) with the frame's fork. See the schematic arrangement in illustration 100211.
Fit 1 EA each of ML Mountain Handlebars (Product Number HB-M763) and ML Mountain Seat Assembly (Product Number SA-M237) to the frame.
Fit 1 EA of ML Mountain Front Wheel (Product Number FW-M762) at the front and 1 EA of ML Mountain Rear Wheel (Product Number RW-M762) at the rear.

Fit 1 EA each of ML Bottom Bracket (Product Number BB-8107), ML Crankset (Product Number CS-6583) and ML Mountain Pedal (Product Number PD-M340). The direct BOM lists the pedal component as 1 EA; do not infer an additional quantity.
